notes.title: Full Version is Coming Soon
notes.content: We continue to work on the full version of our game at full speed and aim to introduce it to you as soon as possible.

notes.title: Frightened Great Graveyard update is here!
notes.content:
Hello dear Frightened players.

A new update for Frightened is at the door; After a long break, Frightened returns with the Graveyard Map. Our map; It tells a chain of events that occur after a mistake made by the Paradise company. In this map, you can discover the secret cellar; You will experience fearful moments.

I Give You the Recipe for Winning
1- We are collecting the babies, but be careful, they are a little fickle :)
2- We purify the babies we collected on the purification platform downstairs.
3- We go to church and cremate our baby beautifully.

AAAA But he is angry now, what should I do?
It's simple, actually, you leave the church door and go straight, you donate a cross to the woman in front of you and she takes care of everything for you.

Some Things That Have Changed in the New Map
-Actually, the monster block system that we willingly added is no longer on this map, monsters will now continue their way through you.
-The monsters in the game will no longer get angry immediately, you will start the game with a mercy period of 6.5 minutes. If you perform the baby ritual within 6.5 minutes, the time will be erased and the spells holding the monsters will be broken and they will begin to haunt you.
-Monster running speeds have changed, they are faster than before 🙂

Good games already. -Entry Studios Team

notes.title: Frightened Story Game is Coming
notes.content:
First of all, hello everyone, I came to you with good news, but there are a few things I need to mention first. We said that we would bring a new map for Frightened and we started working on it, but some of our friends in the team had to take leave for a while. Since the new map will be a huge update, it will be a little difficult to do it before the gaps in the team are filled, so we had to take a short break until the friends who were on leave arrive.

Of course, we did not stay idle and started focusing on our new game, Paradise's Secrets. This game will be the story mode of the Frightened game, or more precisely, the game that tells the story behind the Frightened game. The Steam page is now open. If you want to support us, you can add our new game to your wish list.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601580/Paradises_Secrets/

notes.title: New Map Coming Soon...
notes.content:
Greetings to all, dear Frightened players.

We're constantly working on bringing new updates to Frightened, and now we're back with a huge update. Our work for our new map, Asylum, continues at full speed, we plan to produce the best work we can and present it to you as soon as possible, but we still have a long way to go because we are changing everything. Frightened will be like a reborn, you, our dear players, will realize it while playing.

A great story comes with it on our map. I can't talk about the story completely, but if I have to give a clue, you will experience the unfortunate event that happened to a nurse in a mental hospital who did bad things, and you will experience the peace of our nurse.

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE
notes.content:
Yo yo yo, it's MaviDavsan here! I'm excited to share with you some features we've added to Frightened, inspired by your valuable feedback as players and recommendations from our awesome streamer friends.

-We have changed the color palette of the game atmosphere to be more visually appealing.

-An in-game assistant has been included.

-We've given the lobby interface a refresh, making it more user-friendly.

-AI improvements have been implemented (ongoing work to make them even better).

-The catch rate for rats has been increased. Old: 60% - 40% New: 75% - 25%

-The hologram of the creature is less aggressive.

-The vision of fallen players now turns red.

-And we have fixed some bugs.

We will continue to work as hard as we can to provide you with a better gaming experience. You can support us by providing feedback through our Discord server or by leaving reviews of our game.

                                                        From the Frightened development team      - MaviDavsan

notes.title: Mission System Added !!!!
notes.content:
Frightened is here with a new update.

-The quest system has been added to the game that shows you how to play the game.

-Unlocked some doors in the game

-The hologram creature's running speed has been reduced and its respawn time increased after killing someone

-Studies have been made to find the keys more easily

-Fixed a few minor bugs

and other little things...

Let's not forget that our game is in early access.
